clauses.clause: When this creature enters, target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [cast] variants: trigger on entry; 'ask target' offers every creature on both sides incl. itself; you_bear 2/2 -> 4/2, opp_giant 4/4 -> 6/4, card 3/1 -> 5/1; 'after the turn ends' each reverts. Also triggers when put onto the battlefield on the opponent's turn (the pump has worn off by that turn's end).
